module_summary: AXI-stream statistics counter: counts cycles, bytes and frames on a monitored stream; on trigger it snapshots the counters and a 2-state FSM serializes tag plus counts byte-by-byte through a skid-buffered AXI-stream output.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: IDLE/OUTPUT_DATA readout FSM; starts on trigger, ends after last byte.

anchors.name: tick_count_reg
anchors.why: Cycle counter incremented every clock, cleared on trigger.

anchors.name: byte_count_reg
anchors.why: Byte counter incremented by tkeep count on monitored transfers.

anchors.name: frame_count_reg
anchors.why: Frame counter incremented on first beat of each monitored frame.

anchors.name: frame_reg
anchors.why: In-frame flag so frame_count increments once per frame.

anchors.name: tick_count_output_reg
anchors.why: Snapshot of counters held during serialization; representative of byte/frame output regs.

anchors.name: store_output
anchors.why: Load enable capturing counters into output snapshot registers.

anchors.name: frame_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Byte index into tag/count frame selecting m_axis_tdata_int and tlast.

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata_int
anchors.why: Selected output byte from tag or snapshot registers.

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid_int
anchors.why: Internal valid from FSM into the output skid buffer.

anchors.name: m_axis_tready_int_reg
anchors.why: Registered internal ready gating FSM byte advance.

anchors.name: temp_m_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer temp register holding a byte when output stalls.

anchors.name: temp_m_axis_tvalid_reg
anchors.why: Temp register occupied flag driving early ready and temp-to-output.

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_output
anchors.why: Loads output registers from internal datapath.

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_temp
anchors.why: Loads skid temp registers when output is stalled.

anchors.name: store_axis_temp_to_output
anchors.why: Moves skid temp data into output registers.

anchors.name: monitor_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Monitored stream valid; with tready marks counted transfers.

anchors.name: monitor_axis_tready
anchors.why: Monitored stream ready qualifying byte and frame counting.

anchors.name: monitor_axis_tkeep
anchors.why: Monitored byte enables converted to byte count.

anchors.name: monitor_axis_tlast
anchors.why: Monitored end-of-frame marker clearing frame_reg.

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output status byte stream from m_axis_tdata_reg.

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output valid from m_axis_tvalid_reg.

anchors.name: m_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream ready steering output/temp register transfers.

anchors.name: m_axis_tlast
anchors.why: Marks final byte of the statistics frame.

anchors.name: trigger
anchors.why: Starts snapshot, counter clear and frame readout from IDLE.

anchors.name: tag
anchors.why: Tag bytes prepended to the output statistics frame.

anchors.name: busy
anchors.why: Level busy while FSM is outside IDLE.

groups.name: readout_fsm
groups.description: Trigger-started FSM stepping frame_ptr through tag and count bytes.

groups.name: stat_counters
groups.description: Cycle, byte and frame counters fed by the monitored stream.

groups.name: snapshot_mux
groups.description: Counter snapshot registers and byte select feeding the output path.

groups.name: output_skid_buffer
groups.description: Output and temp registers forming an AXI-stream skid buffer.
